He explained what the issue was in a way that was easy to understand, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was running perfectly before leaving.

I called the company with hopes that this clogged toilet wouldn't be to hard to clear out. They were able to get me an appointment for the next day and came out quickly in between the discussed time slot. They also honored their flyer which cut the cost considerably helping me out alot. The technician they sent Jay Mckenna was professional, super helpful, polite, and very personable. He got in, knocked it out and was on his way quickly. Will definitely use this company again for the future.

Jay did an excellent job at our home today. He was very thorough and very comprehensive during his review of our home and didn’t leave any stone unturned and took the time to explain his approach and what he was looking to identify.

I felt very comfortable and trusting in his approach. While we found a couple of things to tackle, Jay was able to fix our issues and support us with a couple of other questions which we really appreciated his insight on.

The phone support and scheduling with Dalla

We had  two check up services done this week.  One for plumbing with a water tank flush.  And one for the HVAC.

Erik with plumbing was very helpful and did a thorough check. He pointed out a few things we could do on our own to protect our water system.  And, he saw a few things that we should plan to have done sometime this year.

I highly recommend Dallas Plumbing HVAC. They have installed our air conditioners and serviced them for many years. Michael Nunez did an exceptional job with my Fall maintenance. He is thorough, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain things to me so I can continue to take good care of my HVAC system. A big thank you to Aaron and Michael!  Well done!

I had an excellent experience with Dallas Plumbing. Trevor was professional, friendly, and very thorough. He checked everything carefully, explained things clearly and made sure the job was done perfectly. I really appreciated his honesty and dedication to quality work. I highly recommend Dallas Plumbing and especially Trevor for outstanding service!

Titus did an outstanding job for us on our HVAC maintenance service request.  He was on time, courteous and efficient, providing me with detailed photos and explanations of how our two units were operating.  He identified a couple of issues and was able to repair them  during the appointment.  It was very clear to me that this young man is very skilled at what he does!  I would definitely request him again!
Annette P.

Trevor was excellent! I’ve had previous disastrous experiences with a different plumbing company so I was nervous. Trevor was quick, efficient, fixed my leaking refrigerator line, and helped me explain to neighbors about the water shut off during the fix. Great experience all around!

I want to thank Jay for helping me understand what he was doing and how to better improve the situation with my water heaters.  He also did a house check on the plumbing system and presented his ideas for some changes in the future.  Great job Jay!!!

The team did great. All in all a very good job done by first the inspector and then secondly by the technician who installed the hard start switch and the new contact. I have to commend the technician that performed the HVAC service first, if not for him being thorough and running through the checks and balances during the inspection, I would have never know the unit needed a new contact or a hard start kit. Deciding to install them both was a no brainer considering the parts are for safety and

I am extremely pleased with the total professionalism of the first call to the receptionist, a follow up from the dispatcher and a heads'up call from the plumber, Daniel, who was very courteous, competent (calling his supervisor to help demonstrating that he was eager to get the right answers if not from himself!) and i await

Michael and Osvaldo did a great job. I had reported that the UV light on the air purifier needed replacing, but it had only been a year since we had replaced it before.  They thoroughly checked out the unit, finding the an electrical connection inside the unit was not securely fastened.  One fastened the existing UV light began working again.  Great job!  And thank you Michael and Osvaldo.

Michael and Don were out today and did a very thorough and complete semi-annual maintenance. They provided a detail report and provided options that were laid out clearly. I was able to make an "in the moment" informed decision for the needed work. I got it scheduled and approved the estimate before they left.

My second time using them for maintenance and I’m always impressed with how professional they are. They’re friendly, informative and do a great job overall. Ask for Don as your technician, he’s fantastic!

Had a GREAT experience today with Dallas Plumbing & Air Conditioning! My AC stopped working and they fit me in same day, diagnosed, and fixed with honest explanations and pricing. Carlos was respectful and knowledgeable. I highly recommend for any of your home needs!

Donny M. walked through my door with a fantastic presence! I so appreciated how he asked questions about the project and then went right to it! He explained everything in advance and in no time at all, he had done a superior job! He asked me to check out his work and I was very pleased. He left the bathroom in great shape; no trash left behind. He gave me the extra 'stuff' that came with the equipment and explained what it was for. Would I have Donny M. back for future jobs? You bet cha!

Dallas Plumbing and Air Conditioning did an amazing job. We called them to service our HVAC unit (we have a membership with them for service) and we decided to get a new system due to the repairs needed to our old system. Communication was really good. Response time was the best. They made sure and took care of all our questions, concerns, made changes with no hesitation, addressed every potential problem, and made sure we were completely happy with any corrections needed. Tye, Martin, Edrick, M

Jay McKenna was very professional as he diagnosed our AC issues and Lined up an HVAC unit installation on short notice.  He explained the process and our options in detail.
Justin the HVAC supervisor got the system set up and working in record time. Our AC unit died on the hottest day of the year and this team was able to get our ac up and running within 24hrs.

Dallas Plumbing & Air Conditioning came to my home to check out my A/C system; four days later, I was spellbound!!! Where to start... the communication, professionalism, level of knowledge, leadership, kindness, amazing customer service, etc... Titus, Hadi, Joshua, Justin and ALL others blew our minds with...just EVERYTHING! They went above and beyond my expectations. They left my home in order as though nothing had ever been done. Jim treated our issue with care and the highest level of professionalism. He was transparent with the unit’s condition, our purchase options, and kept us well-informed throughout. I would highly recommend him to anyone needing service.

We bought the extended warranty, but apparently that only covers the water heater itself not the fixtures that they used to install the water heater. So nothing of this required repair was covered. They fixed the leaking fixture quickly (20-30min)… which is good. They arrived promptly, also good. But I had to pay $383.00.  Seems very expensive for a quick pipe fitting repair. We received incredible service! Jay kept us informed about our plumbing issue. He was attentive to our financial situation and helped us decide the best path with our repairs. I would recommend Dallas Plumbing and Jay for any future repairs!

They got here and told me the camera was for the drains and this was more of a whole house inspection,  which I didn't want. The tech wanted to quiz me and I wasn't having it. I finally had to ask him to move his truck as he was blocking the neighbors drive. Needless to say, I'll never use them again. I'm not a fan of Ba

Excellent work and tech. Cleared my drain quickly on a promo ad online. Trevor was able to come on a Saturday, earlier than expected. Very professional. Went over the estimate and other work options very clearly. Made sure I approved the estimate and completion.

Our water heater is making popping sounds. I wanted to get sediments out hence signed up for a flush. During the flushing no sediments came out.  We have 2 water heaters connected in parallel. Not sure technician did the job correctly. It is unusual that no sediments came out. I will need plan B.

Jim Ford and Aaron Bryant thoroughly and thoughtfully checked our entire system from our request. They took the time to explain in detail issues regarding an old AC system along with options. I highly recommended DPC and please ask for these two guys! Our family was pleased with the customer service and attention to detail. 👍 …
Hadi with HVAC was amazing!  He provided excellent service, explained why my HVAC systems needed a new part and fixed the problem during the same visit as the inspection.  Very personable!

My technician Titus and his helper did an excellent job. He explained to me everything that was wrong and what needed to be done. They were very professional during the entire time. They went all the way out to make sure I was satisfied. I'm very pleased with their work and your company. Thank you guys so much and keep up the good work.

Michael's knowledge of the A/C systems was quite obvious throughout the entire inspection and maintenance process. Michael and Dirk were very professional as they thoroughly and patiently checked the systems. After checking and cleaning the systems, Michael was very detailed as he explained and showed pictures of his work and findings. They really put my mind at ease concerning possible issues with our systems. We are completely satisfied with today's service.

I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a plumber, specifically Jay! We had a leak in our front yard, he came and gave us his honest opinion. We chose to do a spot repair and unfortunately another leak came 3 weeks later, he spoke to his manager and got them to use the money we had already spent on the spot repair towards the replacement of the entire pipe. However, I wanted to take time and highlight these two guys from Dallas Plumbing.

Michael and Oswaldo did an excellent job with our six-month maintenance. They were very informative and ensured we understood all of their services and recommendations.

We took Dallas Plumbing up on their $79 warranty service and couldn't be happier. Our technician, Erick Gonzalez, was great. He serviced our system and flushed the primary a/c line as well as checking the outdoor unit.  All for $79. He was on time. Which was early on a Saturday morning.  We're so glad we took advantage of their warranty service.

Jay McKenna was very professional, knowledgeable, and patient.  We wouldn’t consider another Dallas area company for any future plumbing issues and/or maintenance.  Long time Dallas Plumbing customer, new client of Jay, specifically. Highly recommend.

Wish I could give 10 stars!
I have recommended Dallas Plumbing for two decades! Without question the best plumbing services in the metroplex. Trevor was my tech and he was professional, knowledgeable, polite and respectful. I trust Dallas Plumbing and appreciate
a totally stress free experience from Trevor.

Today Dallas Plumbing came out to check out my AC unit. Michael provided great service along with another young man in training. Their work was vey thorough and they went over everything in detail. And most especially, Michael provided excellent customer service. And that can make all the difference. You are lucky to have him on your team.

We had a plumbing emergency and Shawn came, when the problem was bigger than expected, Dallas Plumbing team helped us choose the best solution. Shawn came multiple times to make sure the job was done right! He’s the best!

Jim is a very nice, friendly, and responsible guy. He spends a lot of time and explains things to me. I am very impressed when he takes a picture of the preventive care plan and forwards it to the scheduler to ensure all the services will be provided.

Thank you Dallas Plumbing - especially Jay - whose patience and expertise were evident when we asked him to walk through our house and troubleshoot every faucet, sink, toilet and the hot water heater. We live in a 25+ year old house and needed eyes on everything. Jay is very knowledgeable and so helpful! TY!
